notes:
CRM notes - Linden Intelligence (fin svc) - evaluation for RAG/enterprise search; heavy emphasis on embeddings + reranking, connector guarantees.

- Background: Corporate search and regulatory QA for lending docs and communication records. Need high recall for compliance hits + fast rerank to show prioritized results to agents.
- Scale: target index size 80M - 150M vectors; expected steady-state upsert throughput ~200k/day, peak bulk ingest 10M+ monthly during archival migrations. Want connector to support bulk file formats (parquet, ndjson) + streaming upserts.
- Latency/Throughput SLOs: p50 <= 120ms for retrieval (first-stage ANN), p95 <= 500ms including reranker for 10-20 candidate set. Concurrent QPS target 200 for enterprise search UI; burst to 1k QPS for bulk automation. Cost sensitivity: aiming for $0.003 - $0.01 per query (embeddings + retrieval + rerank budget conscious).
- Model preferences: Open models for embeddings (sentence-transformer family), custom fine-tuned reranker (small cross-encoder) deployed on Redwood Dedicated or Private. Want ability to route cheap queries to quantized variants and escalate to higher-quality model on fallback.
- Vector DB preferences / connector wishlist: evaluating Pinecone (managed), pgvector (in-house), Weaviate (hybrid), Elastic (enterprise multi-index). Critical connector features:
    * delta upserts / real-time streaming ingestion + idempotency
    * bulk ingest (parquet/ndjson) with schema preview
    * namespace / tenant isolation (multi-namespace per BU)
    * combined vector + scalar filtering (date range, account id, compliance flags)
    * hybrid search support (sparse + dense blending) and per-query weighting
    * control over ANN index type and metric (cosine, dot, euclidean)
    * on-the-fly reindexing + background rebuilds without downtime
    * multi-region replication, snapshots, and restore for auditability
    * RBAC and fine-grained API keys tied to KMS + audit logs
    * cost / token accounting hooks for reranker calls
- POC plan: baseline ingest 10M vectors to compare Pinecone managed index vs pgvector (self-hosted on EKS). Evaluate: recall@10, recall@100, p50/p95 retrieval latency, reranker end-to-end latency, cost per 1k queries. SE to provide sample ingestion scripts and connector perf matrix.
- Security/compliance: must pass security intake (Okta SSO + SAML), SOC2 evidence, KMS/HSM integration, data residency for EU customers (some datasets must not leave eu-west-1).
- Quotes / paraphrase: CTO - "If retrieval step pushes p50 >120ms it's a non-starter. We also need proof that indexing 100M vectors won't break our retention policies." AE notes: CTO also asked for explicit connector SLA around replication and restore times.
- Commercial: looking at Dedicated capacity with optional Private deployment for sensitive datasets. Initial ARR target range $150k-$450k depending on discounts for committed capacity.
- Open questions: how Redwood connectors handle partial failures during massive bulk ingest? support for partitioned vector namespaces? detailed cost model for reranker + retrieval at scale?
- Next actions: AE to deliver connector performance matrix and sample ingest scripts (by 2026-03-14). Schedule SSO deep-dive w/ security (proposed 2026-03-20). SE to produce rough cost-per-query scenarios for Pinecone vs pgvector.
- Artifacts: POC pricing deck (drive link), security intake form (submitted 2026-03-10), Fireflies ff_2026-02-22_1845 transcript, Jira RWD-4521 created for connector questions.
